reason: 该插件的核心用途是在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 `/ocr` 命令将当前工作区内的 PDF/图片文件交给本地 PaddleOCR 进行识别，并将结果导出为 Markdown。其功能集中于文档/媒体文本提取与结果归档，风险主要来自本地文件读取与脚本执行。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 PaddleOCR 工具，支持 `/ocr` 命令识别工作区内的 PDF 与图片文件，并将识别结果输出到 artifacts/paddle-ocr 的 Markdown 文件。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a local PaddleOCR tool to DeepSeek Harness, enabling the `/ocr` command to process workspace PDF/image files and output extracted results as Markdown files under artifacts/paddle-ocr.

capabilities: Reads workspace PDF/PNG/JPG/WEBP/BMP/TIFF files for OCR
Invokes a local Python-based PaddleOCR process
Writes OCR output as Markdown files in artifacts/paddle-ocr

reasons.code: Human command `/ocr <文件路径> [ch|en]` and supported formats are documented as workspace-only files, limiting input scope.
Plugin is packaged as a DSH bundle with a specific tool entry (`paddle_ocr`) and command wiring.
Repository includes `scripts/paddle_ocr.py` and `index.js`, indicating local script execution for processing.
